meta.parties: Rammenika, W.M. v. Kiri Banda, R.M

rules.statement: It is not open to the Court to frame an issue on what really formed the consideration unless both parties consent.
rules.supporting_quote: "The contention of the first defendant's proctor in the Court below appears to me to be sound. While by our law, both before and after the Evidence Ordinance of 1895, a party to a deed may be allowed merely to negative the statement therein as to what I may call the transit of consideration, or to show that the particular consideration mentioned therein has failed, it is not open to him to show that the consideration was other than that stated in the deed, and that there was a failure of that other consideration."
